title: Jack Daniel's Distillery Tour from Nashville with Tasting
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Journey from Nashville to Lynchburg for an immersive experience at the iconic Jack Daniel's Distillery. Discover the rich history of Tennessee whiskey as you explore the charming town of Lynchburg, where you’ll have time for lunch and shopping. Enjoy a guided tour of the distillery, complete with a whiskey tasting flight to savor the unique flavors. This tour is perfect for whiskey enthusiasts and those looking to learn more about the craft behind this famous spirit.

- Total tour duration is approximately 7 hours, including travel time.
- Luxury transportation provided to and from your Nashville hotel or AirBNB.
- Guided tour includes a whiskey tasting experience and time to explore Lynchburg.
- Minimum group size of 4 participants required for the tour to operate.
